signs.label: Salaam Alaikum
signs.note: As demonstrated in the ESL Zayed video: the right hand salutes at the forehead, then comes down to a fist held near the chest.

signs.label: How are you
signs.note: As demonstrated in the ESL Zayed video: an open hand with spread fingers on the chest, then a thumbs-up.

signs.label: Fine
signs.note: As demonstrated in the ESL Zayed video: both hands move in front of the chest, ending in two thumbs-up.

signs.label: Thank you
signs.note: As demonstrated in the ESL Zayed video: the right flat hand rises to the side of the face, then moves down and forward toward the chest.

signs.label: You are welcome
signs.note: As demonstrated in the ESL Zayed video: the flat right hand is placed on the chest.
